name: 8-bit Packed Volumetric Masking
definition: A technique to apply voxel-level visibility masks to volumetric data without duplicating the underlying scalar volume data. Masks are stored as 8-bit packed boolean arrays where each byte represents the visibility of 8 adjacent voxels along the X-axis.
summary: 8-bit Packed Volumetric Masking applies voxel-level visibility masks to volumetric data without duplicating scalar data, storing masks as 8-bit packed boolean arrays to reduce memory overhead.
